title: Character stuck against wall, unresponsive to movement inputs for 140 frames
reproduction_steps: Move character to the position seen in frame 41, near the rocky wall edge
Continue pressing directional keys (right/left/down/up) and space to jump
Observe that the character and background remain almost pixel-identical across ~140 frames despite varied inputs
Note pixel_diff_median (0.666) is drastically lower than clean_play_median_diff (22.924), confirming lack of response
suspected_cause: Character likely got stuck on a wall/collision geometry or entered a state (e.g., blocked by an invisible collider or animation lock) that ignored subsequent movement and jump inputs.
evidence_note: Compare frames 79, 118, and 157: character position, pose, and background are nearly identical despite a long, varied sequence of left/right/space/down inputs, indicating the game world was not updating in response to player actions.
